all_required_checks.known_f1_tolerance: mean ASH minus Energy Known F1 >= -0.005 and worst scenario >= -0.02
all_required_checks.metric_breadth: ASH has positive mean oriented gain over Energy on at least 2 of 4 metrics
all_required_checks.overall_gain: mean of four ASH-versus-Energy oriented mean gains is strictly positive
all_required_checks.split_integrity: ASH, source MLP and OpenDetect split fingerprints identical
all_required_checks.suite_robustness: at least 4 of 7 suites have nonnegative four-metric mean gain and worst suite >= -0.05
all_required_checks.top_two_rank: ASH four-unknown-metric mean rank among three pilot methods <= 2.0

failure_action: retain the 14-scenario negative pilot and do not spend the full-matrix budget
full_matrix_action: run all 102 frozen seed7 scenarios only if every required check passes
oriented_metric_rule: higher is better except lower unknown_fpr95 is better
